commits_since_base.subject: feat(services+sandbox): real per-variant proptest shrinking (m8-06 execute)

B1_real_per_variant_shrinking.closes: m8-05 R3 (per-variant strategy returns Just(base); real shrinking is m9+)

test_pyramid.T4_smoke_counterexample_tools: 11/11 (ce1, ce5, ce7, ce10, ce11 all observe real shrinking rounds)

notes.title: f64 -> 0.0 +/- EPSILON
notes.description: NumberShrinker walks the constant toward 0.0 via binary search, but f64 cannot reach exactly 0.0 from a non-zero starting value. Floor is 1e-9 (EPSILON). m9+ could swap in arbitrary-precision if exact zero matters.

notes.title: TextShrinker is lexicographic, not byte-optimal
notes.description: TextShrinker deletes one UTF-8 char at a time. Per proptest convention this is the right shape; m9+ can adopt dictionary-based shrinking for known token sets if needed.

notes.title: Bool shrinker is the identity
notes.description: Bool has only 2 values; Just(b) is the correct minimiser. rounds_used == 1 for Bool targets (initial validation only).

notes.title: ExistencePredicate variant fixed (no cross-variant shrinking)
notes.description: ExistencePredicateShrinker holds the variant (EventTypeEquals / PredicateEquals / etc.) fixed and shrinks the payload string. Cross-variant shrinking would require generating arbitrary ExistencePredicate JSON; significant scope expansion.

notes.title: max_depth = None is terminal
notes.description: CallPathShrinker walks max_depth toward 0 but cannot shrink past None (None is a terminal state, not a value).

notes.title: dyn ValueTree: !Send (carried from m8-05 R7)
notes.description: proptest's ValueTree trait is not Send. drive_strategy rebuilds the strategy + tree each round; tree is never held across .await. Path of least resistance.

notes.title: SBoxedStrategy requirement (carried from m8-05 R5)
notes.description: BoxedStrategy is !Send; the MCP #[tool] wrapper requires Send, so we use SBoxedStrategy. Constraint, not a bug.

notes.title: HypothesisInput: Send + Sync + 'static (carried from m8-05 R4)
notes.description: Required by proptest::test_runner::Config + SBoxedStrategy. The path of least resistance.

notes.title: max_rounds is now wired through as the only infinite-loop guard
notes.description: ShrinkConfig -> proptest::Config mapping added in m8-06 sets max_shrink_iters = s.max_rounds.max(1). Without this wire-up, the default u32::MAX in proptest would let any non-converging shrinker loop forever. DEFAULT_SHRINK_MAX_ROUNDS = 64.
